name: dobe_rubup_keyb
desc: keep this pink goo doberman with the same size, colors and style, seen from behind hugging someone tightly. Change only its pose: it has slid its upper body straight upward along the person while grinding its chest against them, so its head, shoulders, arms and chest are about ten pixels higher than now, its torso is stretched taller and gooey, sticky goo strands stretch below its chest. Its lower body and the goo stalk at the bottom stay exactly where they are, stuck to the pillar. No sideways shift. Same pixel art style.
